headline: STL @ KCR matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is STL 4.50 at KCR 4.62, with a projected total of 9.12. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward KCR: STL moved -0.81 runs while KCR moved +0.23, changing the projected margin by -1.04 runs. The projected total fell -0.58, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +9.3%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Stephen Kolek has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.4 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Carter Jensen, Bobby Witt Jr., Alec Burleson, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Jimmy Crooks because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
